fact: Fish farming is the science, that is the technical know-how, and the art, that is the business, of rearing fish
The 3M of creating wealth in fish farming is Make, Manage and Multiply
In the 3M model the Make is the science, while the Manage and the Multiply are the art
MAKE is the science and foundation of fish farming, and it has ten principles that work interdependently like the fingers of a hand
MAKE principle, Water: the standard quality and quantity of water is required for the fish to grow well
MAKE principle, Land: it determines the nature of soil, the types of ponds whether earthen or concrete, and water availability and quality
MAKE principle, Security: protecting the investment by fencing the farm, installing a CCTV camera and hiring a security guard
MAKE principle, Location: where the farm is sited may make or mar it, for example a flooded inaccessible road hinders progress, while high demand at a high price with no rivals brings profit
MAKE principle, Fisheries knowledge and manpower: a major key to making wealth, since sound knowledge in rearing, breeding and marketing is an essential prerequisite for a bountiful harvest
MAKE principle, Source of supply of fingerlings or juveniles: the genetic composition of the parental stock determines the growth of the fingerlings and juveniles
MAKE principle, Feed availability and quality: locating the farm near the agricultural market where high-quality feed ingredients are sold all year round adds to sustainability
MAKE principle, Market: market research finds out who the customers are, the price of fish, the competitors and other factors
MAKE principle, Construction: a badly constructed pond can flood or have broken walls, releasing fish that are stolen or die, so professionals rather than quacks should build fishponds
MAKE principle, Finance: create a budget for farm expenditure before starting, and rear the quantity of fish the budget can take care of

MANAGE is the principle of managing money already made so that it does not reduce, and it has five elements: keeping records, financial prudence, communication skills, diligence and effective human resources management
MANAGE element, keeping records: monitoring expenditure and revenue gives a road map on whether the farm is making a profit or a loss
MANAGE element, financial prudence: having a budget does not mean spending the whole amount, and costs are cut by doing jobs yourself or taking trainees who pay to learn
MANAGE element, communication skills: the way you talk to employees either kills their interest or motivates them, so use polite words and avoid abusive language
MANAGE element, diligence: it starts with the owner, because a diligent owner finds it easier to instil discipline and work ethics in employees

MANAGE element, effective human resources management: the culture and value system is made known before employment and backed by a code of conduct, policies, regulations, discipline, training, controls and promotion

MULTIPLY is engaging in multiple streams of sustainable revenue after making and managing wealth, and it has six tasks: technological input, leverage and networking, the marketing mix, investment, reward mechanism and an integrated approach
MULTIPLY task, technological input: drones, AI sensors, automated feeders and apps increase productivity and harvest
MULTIPLY task, leverage and networking: no man is an island, so what you do not have can be got from another company for mutual benefit, such as engaging a transport company to convey fish
The marketing mix, the 7Ps, is product, promotion, place, price, physical evidence which is packaging, people, and process which is positioning
The 4Cs of marketing are customer, cost, convenience and communication, putting the customer first because the customer is king
MULTIPLY task, investment: the profit from the fish farm can be diversified into other businesses such as stocks and shares that are not agriculturally based
MULTIPLY task, reward mechanism for staff and customers: rebates or special awards and gifts win sincere loyalty
MULTIPLY task, integrated approach with agro-allied and agriculturally based businesses: for example the optimal utilisation of the generator and water pumps
The diagnostic models for research and development before starting or expanding are SWOT analysis and SMART analysis

The research and development questions also ask what others have done, what aspect has not been fully developed, how to make it happen, what innovation and creativity can distinguish the business, what the marketing strategies are, and what the packaging will look like

A unitary fish farmer gets income from one source, but the best approach to a free-flowing income is to be creative, maximise available resources, reduce unnecessary costs and increase productive output
Production costs are reduced by producing your own feed, using technology, and proper farm management that minimises waste, for example running fish, maize and poultry on the same farm
Market research identifies the most profitable fish species, the best-selling sizes and the target buyers, so the fish is sold at the best price
Sustainable wealth is created by diversification into smoked fish and fish fillets, and by integrating fish farming with crop farming and with agro-allied businesses
Sustainable wealth is created by reducing waste and costs: using automatic feeders, converting fish water effluents into organic fertiliser for crops, and using interns to reduce manpower cost
Sustainable wealth is created by learning and networking through workshops, training and associations, by reinvesting profit to scale up, and by focusing on daily water quality management
